description: Reads the complete bounded document returned by search_reference, with its revisions and attribution. Each section that is a rule, ability, stratagem, enhancement, detachment rule, mission card or core rule carries its ruleSummary: Praetorium’s own wording of the rule, never the official text, with a stratagem’s when, target, effect and restrictions apart where its summary is written in parts. Answer rules questions from it. A section with no summary lists textSources instead: the pinned upstream file and record id that print its words.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

id.description: A reference id such as datasheet:necrons:necron-warriors: a result id from search_reference, a mission pack id from list_reference, or a referenceId from list_units or simulate_combat. Names, URLs, and unit ids are not reference ids.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: get_reference

ruleSummary.description: Praetorium’s own wording of the rule, in Markdown: a summary written for Praetorium, not the official text. A Stratagem’s summary written in parts also gives its when, target, effect and restrictions apart.

textSources.description: Where withheld rules text lives upstream, given only where Praetorium has no summary of the rule: the pinned file, its source, and the id of the record holding it there when the file has one.

title: Read one Praetorium reference result
